name: Regular Roads Advisory Committee Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA

  CITY OF LA HABRA HEIGHTS
  ROADS ADVISORY COMMITTEE

  1245 N. Hacienda Road
  La Habra Heights, California 90631

  6:30 p.m. Regular Business

  March 23, 2022
*Pursuant to AB 361 and City Council Resolution No. 2021-25, this meeting will be a
hybrid meeting in which Committee Members may join virtually.

The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.
If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the
City Clerk’s office at (562) 694-6302.

Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Roads Advisory Committee
after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection with the City
Clerk at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business
hours.

PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
In conjunction with Federal, State and Los Angeles County public health regulations, the
public may physically attend Roads Advisory Committee meetings. Due to limited
designated seating, members of the public will be allowed to enter on a first come, first
served basis. To protect Committee Members, members of the public and staff, face
masks are required indoors at City Hall. The City will evaluate the current circumstances
before each meeting to decide if it is safe to change ongoing COVID-19 safety protocols
in place. Members of the public may also go to www.Lhhcity.org to view the live broadcast
of the Roads Advisory Committee meeting.

For public comments, you may submit comments on any agenda item or item not on the
agenda in writing via mail to City of La Habra Heights, ATTN: Roads Advisory Committee,
1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 or via email to Info@Lhhcity.org.
The public may also provide public comments on any agenda item or item not on the

  VIEW THE ROADS ADVISORY COMMITTEE MEETING LIVE AT: WWW.LHHCITY.ORG
 agenda during Item No. 4, PUBLIC COMMENTS, via phone at (562) 694-6302 Ext. 0. If
you would like to provide public comment via telephone, please begin your call once the
Chair calls the meeting to order. Please note that the Roads Advisory Committee is
making every effort to follow the spirit and intent of the Brown Act and other applicable
laws regulating the conduct of public meetings in order to maximize transparency and
public access. It would be appreciated if communications of public comments are
provided prior to the commencement of the meeting.

Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed
on the agenda or other matters within the Committee's purview except with regard to
items listed as public hearings. In addition, each member of the public may also speak
during the second Public Comment segment for no more than one minute concerning
matters not on the agenda. To speak in the Public Comment segment please complete
and deliver a speaker's card to the Clerk prior to the call for public comments. You will be
called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak. All Public Comments shall be
made in accordance with Section 6 and Section 8 of the City of La Habra Heights Rules
of Procedure.

Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum
of NINE (9) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed
to the Committee.

OPENING CEREMONIES

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL: Chair Tony Donato, Vice Chair John Steele, Members Paul LoNigro,
  Ross Owen, Glen Pedersen, and John Richert

3.  FLAG SALUTE

4.  PUBLIC COMMENT

CONSENT CALENDAR

  MEETING

  RECOMMENDATION:  Approve.

  -------------------------------- END OF CONSENT CALENDAR --------------------------------
